summary: Phoenix New Media filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, to be held November 20, 2026 in Beijing at 2:00 p.m., with a record date of October 20, 2026. Exhibits include the press release, meeting notice, proxy statement, form of proxy, and ADS voting card; ADS holders vote underlying Class A shares through depositary JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or ownership changes are stated. This is a routine AGM notice mapped to a US annual meeting proxy, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
